title: centranthera cochinchinensis var. nepalensis
intro: Centranthera cochinchinensis var. nepalensis, commonly known as Himalayan centaury, is a type of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve fever, and reduce pain, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Centranthera cochinchinensis var. nepalensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
